title: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter

suppliers.sup:70530: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and a Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – 24-month proposal for part:350020
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for your offer. Our forecast fc:350020@2026-09 records a 10.3% change, and we expect 4,580 pcs per year. We would like to secure this volume with you for 24 months rather than 12, which gives you a stable load and planning certainty through 2028.

In return for the longer commitment, we propose the attached packages on 90 or 60 days payment terms. As both prices exceed the 2% threshold, could you please put them to your pricing committee at its next meeting? We would also appreciate a short cost breakdown supporting the requested increase.

Best regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – 24-month proposal for part:350020
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We can accept your terms and await your order.

For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €436.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Credit Control: Please be advised that our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.
